# Policy-KB bijection audit — collection_appointments / task 0

- revision: 1; auditor: erl-kb-doc-policy-audit run (independent of render and policy-side audit); written after the runtime blind answer was frozen (`runtime_context/collection_appointments/0.md`, freeze sha256 `00e356f2…`).
- source: `tasks/collection_appointments/visits.extended.yaml` (base + `extended_policies`), `task_tools.py`; corpus: the 67 documents of `docs/visits/` (dump sha256 `6d1374f1…`), title + content only (hidden meta not used as evidence).
- scope of this task: `visits_ext_trip_charge`, `visits_ext_household_charge`, `visits_ext_weekend_charge`, `visits_ext_home_visit_settlement`, and the base policies governing their subjects (`visits_evt_fee_assessment`, `visits_evt_fee_payment_and_refund`, `visits_evt_fee_waiver`), the Mobile In-Home variant parameters they read, and the four task-tool contracts. The other base policies and parameter tables of the product were swept as well (shared corpus).

- `visits_evt_fee_assessment` → `assessment_of_collection_service_fees_bbbdb0d0`: A.1 status gate, A.2 one line/at most once, A.3 homebound, A.4 late-cancellation/no-show follow the cancellation rule, no-show never trip, A.5 incomplete/recollection, A.6 PSC/pediatric/timed/facility no patient fees — all in force. Retired (declared by overwrite of trip, household, weekend and settlement): zone trip fee, AP per member, weekend surcharge, card-on-file at completion — each written as "no longer in force"; no undeclared retirement.
- `visits_evt_fee_payment_and_refund` → `fee_payment_and_refunds_84a466d7`: empty list → no patient-paid fees; refund on waiver within refund days; refund on lab cancellation; refund at most once; separate from test charges / not on plans / not reduced by assistance — in force. Retired "paid in full in one payment with a method listed" (declared by both settlement overwrites) — written as retired.
- `visits_evt_fee_waiver` → `fee_waivers_ce02ec09` (+ `fee_waiver_payment_refund_terms_d757b25e`): full never partial, one reason, four reasons, courtesy only late-cancellation/no-show when the patient asks while count < allowance, measure (365 days, today included), window day 0 inclusive, never courtesy for trip/AP/weekend, at most once, refund — complete.
- Mobile In-Home parameters read (trip_fee_by_zone 75/95/125, additional_patient_fee 35.00, max 3, weekend_surcharge 35.00, homebound waiver, payment methods, fee_due_timing at_completion, refund 7 days, courtesy 1, window 30) — `collection_service_fee_schedule_5366b36f`, `fee_waiver_payment_refund_terms_d757b25e`: every figure matches. ## kb_to_source

- Sentence-by-sentence sweep of the 30 documents of this task's four policies (4 hubs, 4 computation documents, 22 factor documents) and the base documents above: every obligation, eligibility, prohibition, calculation, timing and step has a source. Additions checked and found sourced/derivable: "what the patient says about the order does not replace it" (evidence authority system_record); "A charge that was never assessed on the visit stands open for nothing" (SUM over no rows); "When the visit carries fee lines assessed on different dates, the latest of those dates is the posting date" (LATEST); "an active coverage, a coverage pending verification and an inactive coverage are all live" (compute); "The other rejection reasons recorded on orders are hemolyzed, quantity not sufficient, unlabeled or mislabeled, and wrong container" (enumeration of the record's reason values, not a rule); "a figure such as 95.004 ... posted as 95.00" (illustration of round-once).
- No added confirmation, review, notification, re-verification or failure procedure.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none. Each tool name appears only in its own hub (scan of all corpora).
- A task's opening world state written as a policy fact: none (no date, name or id of either task in any document; all examples labelled hypothetical).
- Wording note (not a defect): `redraw_credit_after_rejection_eead0fd3` opens "When a home trip is a redraw for an order whose specimen the laboratory rejected" — the source tier conditions read only the order's rejections in the last three months; the document's truth table, the "tied ... to the order the visit collects" answer, and the base rule that a recollection-purpose visit carries no fee at all keep the entailment equal to the source (a standing-order draw collecting an order with a qualifying rejection takes the credit). Recorded because it is the one sentence a reader must reason past.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No atom unborne, none borne with changed meaning, no claim from outside the source; every prerequisite sentence verbatim on its blocked side only; every declared factor ladder complete in its own document; retired surface correct. First revision; no earlier revision exists.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. Each extended rule's first sentence (the overwrite `replaced_by`: "worked out by the steps below rather than read straight off the published zone fee / as a flat amount per member / as one flat surcharge") is source law and is carried in the hubs; it tells any reader that the posted figure is not the flat published figure, which sits in tension with the design that a reader missing every factor gets no signal. It is not a KB addition.
2. The source's `Order of the calculation` sentence (rendered under `result`, owned by the computation document) names factor steps; the corpus carries it in factor-neutral words ("any amount added to the trip", "Percentage allowances on a settlement are first added together", "multiplied in turn by each multiplier the weekend charge carries"). This is the render contract's required assembly carriage, not a pointer; noted because these generic slots inevitably reveal that additions/multipliers/allowances can exist.
3. `prompt_settlement_allowance` conditions on the quantity decided by `settlement_day_count`; its document must therefore use the term "days to settlement", the title subject of the day-count document. This chaining comes from the source ladders.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentences: 6 edges, each verbatim, state form kept, in the blocked policy's hub; same-form restatements only in the household hub ("Put in terms of the visit's fee record: until that record shows an assessed trip fee, the household charge of the visit is not yet fixed.") — not RED.
- No state-form sentence restated as an action, no performer/resolving problem named beside it, no other problem's tool named in any blocked hub, no route, checklist, dependency table or aggregated chain (scan for ordering wording over all 67 documents: every hit is a source clause, a prerequisite sentence, a computation-assembly order or a lifecycle rule).
- Titles: general subjects ("Settlement of Home-Visit Service Charges by Card", "Trip Charge on Collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visits — Posting Reference", "Specimen Collection Appointments: Household Charge for Additional Members Drawn at a Home Visit", "… Weekend Charge on Saturday and Sunday Home Visits"); no title restates the customer's request or the task's situation.
- Depended-on documents are reachable through the record words and the sentence's own words ("assessed trip fee", "assessed additional-patient fee", "assessed weekend surcharge", which are the fee-line types the fee history shows); KB_search with record words ranks the hubs in the top results.
- Factor documents: none says which tier a customer or most customers fall on, none names a mistake to avoid, none writes evidence rows of the task; none names, overrides or points at the computation document or another factor document (shared quantity names such as "days to settlement" or "assessed trip fee" are inputs, see policy-side note 3). Computation documents: no "unless", "adjustments may apply", "certain customers", "elsewhere", exception list or pointer (scan); assembly slots per policy-side note 2.
- Examples: hypothetical, within one problem; no example walks across problems (the multi-charge example "A Sunday visit with household members drawn, carrying an assessed trip fee, an assessed additional-patient fee and an assessed weekend surcharge: 3 percent" states the factor's own tier condition, not an order between problems).
- Blind-answer hop marks: 6/6 state-derived, 0 pre-solved.

**Verdict: PASS.**
